# Provenance: cura

Copied unmodified on 2026-10-25 from `modules/gcode-parser/test/fixtures/cura/` (gcode-parser 0.8.5), so this module's integration test has a file from each slicer without reaching into another module. Generator, version, settings and licence as stated there, reproduced below.

`cube-cylinder-4.10.0.gcode` is a third-party sample, downloaded unmodified on 2026-10-25 from `https://github.com/kageurufu/preprocess_cancellation` (GPL-3.0, compatible with AGPL-3.0-or-later), commit `44140d6964f2a4c90014309a5b26103cc82164c5`, path `GCode/cura.gcode` (as `raw.githubusercontent.com`). Header: `;Generated with Cura_SteamEngine 4.10.0`, `;FLAVOR:RepRap`, 25 layers, a cylinder and a cube (`;MESH:` markers), one extruder, no arc fitting.

Ultimaker/Cura (LGPL-3.0) and Ultimaker/CuraEngine (AGPL-3.0) carry no sample G-code, so no first-party file exists.
